derived_from: AgentMeasure 2026-09 audit taxonomy (github.com/roy-tong/AgentMeasure, campaigns/audit-report-2026-09.md): five recurring billing-bug classes measured across ~110 usage tools — re-emitted/resumed events double-counted, cache-tokens priced as input, price-table drift vs vendor consoles, resume/fork lineage loss, overflow/clamp handling.

pricing_basis.rule: Every expected cost in this pack is a TOTAL derived from the bundled snapshot (crates/agenttrace-core/src/pricing_snapshot.json) through the catalog formula in crates/agenttrace-core/src/lib.rs (round4 of sum(tokens_class/1e6 * price_class), cache classes at their own rates). The pack embeds no price table of its own: crates/agenttrace-core/tests/token_conformance.rs re-derives every literal from pricing::lookup_price/default_price at run time and fails if a literal drifts from the live snapshot by more than one round4 step (6e-5), so a snapshot refresh that moves a used model's rates forces a pack refresh instead of silently re-blessing old totals.

classes.overflow_clamp: hostile token counts (i64::MAX / 1e300 floats) saturate, never panic or wrap; clamped totals carry the calculated_from_tokens_clamped marker
classes.re_emitted_event: usage re-emitted on the same message id counts once (fold at max per class), never once per emission
classes.cache_priced_as_input: cache write/read tokens price at their own snapshot rates and stay out of net input; cache-inclusive input-basis subtractions are disclosed, not silently zeroed
classes.price_table_drift: rendered totals stay derivable from the bundled snapshot (runtime re-derivation guard); the frozen-first-model misprice is xfail-pinned to rm-663
classes.resume_fork_lineage: post-compaction (rewound cumulative) usage windows count forward once each — no high-water refusal undercount, no double count
classes.unprovable_total: absent/zero/partial evidence renders zero with a disclosure marker or rescues only the provable part; nothing is invented
classes.loud_parse_failure: unparseable hostile journals exit nonzero with a reason; totals are never silently zero

pack-owned fixture; the same message id re-emits its usage three times (resume/stream replay) beside one fresh turn — the fold keeps one usage per id at the max per class. Truth: msg_1 1000/100 once + msg_2 500/50 = 1500/150; double-counting would report 3500/350

pack-owned fixture; net input 1000, output 100, cache write 2000, cache read 5000 on claude-sonnet-4-5. Truth at the snapshot's own cache rates: round4(1000*3e-6 + 100*15e-6 + 2000*3.75e-6 + 5000*0.3e-6) = 0.0135; pricing cache as input would render 0.0255 and folding cache into input would render 0.027

pack-owned sentinel; a plain 3000/300 claude-sonnet-4-5 block whose total (0.0135) must stay derivable from the bundled snapshot — the runtime re-derivation guard fails this case when a snapshot refresh moves the rates and the pack is not refreshed

pack-owned fixture in the rm-554 landed shape; cumulative totals 1000/400, rewound 200/60, regrown 600/300 (last 250/150) — every window's fresh usage counts once: 1000+200+250 in / 400+60+150 out. High-water refusal would report 1000/400 (undercount); summing cumulative totals would report 1800/760 (double count)

pack-owned port of AgentMeasure open issue #24's highest-fidelity malformed vector (message_start-only usage with zero totals): zeros render as zero WITH the zero_usage_reported disclosure — never padded by text estimates, never negative

TRUTH is per-block: round4(0.0045 + 0.045) = 0.0495; the parser currently freezes the first model onto every usage meta and renders 0.0135 (all-sonnet)
